about: Package 7's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/70-workflows.mjs), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; so does a count that changes.

accepted.why: Deviation 6: every button says its type (type="button"); the concept's buttons give none.
A workflow row's revision count says "1 revision" for one; the concept's says "1 revisions" (its label is written without a plural). The core's words.

The concept's tooltip moves a focused or hovered button's title into data-tip-held while its own tip shows (the info button the state clicked, the Revision toggle); the page's tooltips are package 8's, so the title stays.
Deviation 10: the concept's internal flags (a menu item armed for its second press, a save hint holding a refusal); the rebuild keeps them in its state.

The concept's openPop leaves aria-expanded="false" on a menu button after its menu has closed; the rebuild's says aria-expanded only while its menu is open (as before the menu was ever opened, on both pages).

The drafts list opens above the go bar when it fits there (the concept's placeFloat, prefer up); the rebuild's go bar stands higher at Quick, since the prompt card above it is package 4's seam, so the list of two drafts opens below.

Deviation P7-3: a revision's details list its groups in the desk's module order (Adapters, at 50, before the Sampler, at 80), where the concept lists a fixed order (Models, Sampler, Planner, Adapters); and the content's BPM held as 82 reads 82, where the concept's reads the desk's auto switch instead of the revision's.

A HeartMuLa revision's mark paints with a gradient of its own (url(#hmRainbow-<n>), shell/engines.ts logoOf takes the place it stands in), so no id is on the page twice; the concept's marks all name one hmRainbow, which the engine panel's card carries too. The colours are the same.
